Grit goals aur achievement ko jodta.
Mehnat hunar se behtar hai jab hunar mehnat nahi karta.
Courage—right ke liye stand lena, chahe dar ho.
Grit charitra banata hai.
Dukh process ka part hai.
Himmat ka matlab hai, rukna na maan kar aage badhte rehna.
Grit sab kuch jeet leti hai.
Jeetne ke liye, tumhe ek battle ko ek se zyada dafa ladna pad sakta hai.
Himmat endure karne ki ability hai.
Ye hamesha impossible lagta hai, jab tak ho na jaye.
Yeh maayne nahi rakhta ki aap kitna dheere chal rahe hain, bas rukna mat.
Grit suraj hai.
Khamoshi alfaazon se zyada bolti hai.
Zarurat ho to bolo.
Thakne par mat rukna.
Discipline abhi jo chahiye aur jo sabse zyada chahiye ke beech.
Khamoshi darr hai.
Himmat drid hai.
Khamoshi aadhar hai.
